title: Chat panel · ruled 22 Nov (round 1 + round 2)
intro: Ruled 22 Nov: picker A (one list, suggestion first and focused, reason as caption), header H1 (back ⌘[, context chips in the composer), Wiki W1 (chat takes the margin column’s place), key K1 (⌘B chat in Code and Wiki, ⌃⌘S sidebar everywhere), iPad P1 side panel in landscape + P2 sheet in portrait and compact. Rules: rules.md beside this page. The A/B/C round: design/chat-panel-brief/round-1.html; its mixed boards (picker A/B/C, header and Wiki options) in rounds/.

Round 2, 22 Nov, on the built panel: Q1 B (no header Context button; ⌘I cap ends the chip row, dashed “Context ⌘I” chip when there are none), Q2 B (the Wiki ⌘B hint is one line + Got it under the picker header), Q3 hint after New session as muted text, Q4 one copy table, Q5 Back without a label (‹ ⌘[), F6 A (× always, label opens the context detail, one ⌘I cap). F1–F5 confirmed. Round page: design/chat-panel-brief/round-2.html.
